findings.issue: Common noun H2833, definite singular, is left as the untranslated form joshen.
Qal sequential perfect 2ms of H640 is the coined verb efodarás, an untranslated non-name lemma.
Preposition plus 3ms suffix is smoothed to the direct object lo.
Definite construct phrase is a bare cinturón, and en selects one sense of the preposition.

notes: tomarás, vestirás, Aarón, la túnica, el manto del efod, and the repeated efod match person, number, and construct structure.
